title: causalbase: Bayesian network structure learning and causal discovery
description: causalbase learns the structure of Bayesian networks from data. Every search takes every score: BDeu or BIC on categorical data, the Gaussian BIC or BGe on continuous data. The searches are greedy equivalence search (GES) and XGES, iterated local search over variable orders, FLOP, hill climbing and tabu search over DAGs, and exact search by dynamic programming or integer programming; RCD, HC-LiNGAM and HC learn linear non-Gaussian models from higher-order cumulants. Scores and graph routines are compiled with Numba. Structural metrics, BIF and XMLBIF input, forward sampling, five bundled benchmark networks and the download of 226 more from Zenodo are included. fedcausal, which learns from data split across sites, is built on it.
